articles.summary: Companies to develop intelligent imaging solutions for food safety Neogen® Corporation (NASDAQ: NEOG), a global leader in food safety solutions, is advancing its innovation strategy by combining deep food safety expertise with emerging technologies to introduce novel solutions to the Food Safety industry that address evolving customer challenges. As part of that strategy, Neogen today announced a strategic collaboration with and an equity investment in Hinalea Imaging Corp. to develop digital imaging solutions for food safety and quality inspection. Neogen and Hinalea have worked together since 2025 to evaluate applications for hyperspectral imaging in food safety. Building on that work, the companies plan to jointly develop solutions that could improve inspection and testing workflows and help customers interpret results faster and more consistently. articles.summary: Company presented three pillars of value creation fueling its category leadership: commercial prowess, high-impact innovation and operational excellence Neogen Corporation (NASDAQ: NEOG) today hosted its 2026 Investor Day, "Shaping the Future of Food Safety," in New York City, where the company's senior leadership team outlined a comprehensive strategy for sustained profitable growth and category leadership, and provided a framework under which it plans to achieve financial targets by fiscal year 2031. The event featured presentations from Mike Nassif, President and Chief Executive Officer; Bryan Riggsbee, Chief Financial Officer; Dr. Tammi Ranalli, Senior Vice President and General Manager, Global Food Safety; Joe Freels, Chief Commercial Officer; Jeremy Yarwood, Chief Scientific Officer; and Jim Walter, Senior Vice President, Manufacturing and Operations.
